title: ATLAS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Lifting Binary to Canonical Compiler IR
abstract: arXiv:2610.30877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lifting stripped, heavily optimized binaries to a canonical, pre-optimization LLVM intermediate representation (IR) is essential for downstream security analysis and legacy software migration when source code is unavailable. However, aggressive compiler optimizations rewrite control and data flow, remove structural metadata, and introduce type-erased low-level idioms, causing current lifters to produce malformed or semantically divergent IR. We present ATLAS, a multi-agent framework designed to reconstruct formally valid and canonical LLVM IR from optimized disassembly.ATLAS combines (i) Structure-aware, region-level retrieval, which utilizes pseudo-probe attribution to align optimized instructions with canonical IR exemplars, and (ii) a collaborative refinement loop that closes the gap between probabilistic generation and deterministic compiler constraints. translated_title: ATLAS：一个将二进制程序提升为规范编译器中间表示的多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 将去除符号、经过高度优化的二进制程序提升为规范的、优化前的LLVM中间表示（IR），对于在源代码不可用时进行下游安全分析和遗留软件迁移至关重要。然而，激进的编译器优化会重写控制流和数据流、移除结构元数据，并引入类型擦除的低级惯用模式，导致当前的提升器产生格式错误或语义偏离的IR。我们提出了ATLAS，一个旨在从优化后的反汇编代码中重建形式有效且规范的LLVM IR的多智能体框架。ATLAS结合了：（i）结构感知的区域级检索，利用伪探针归因将优化后的指令与规范IR示例对齐；（ii）协作式细化循环，以缩小概率生成与确定性编译器约束之间的差距。具体而言，一个提升智能体基于检索到的……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: ATLAS是一个多智能体框架，通过结构感知的区域级检索与协作式细化循环，将高度优化的无符号二进制程序重建为规范且形式有效的优化前LLVM中间表示。
en_tdlr: ATLAS is a multi-agent framework that reconstructs formally valid, canonical pre-optimization LLVM IR from heavily optimized stripped binaries via structure-aware region-level retrieval and a collaborative refinement loop.
